# utils/scripts/no-spawn-process-allowlist.txt — admitted process-spawn names.
#
# utils/scripts/check-banned-calls.py reads this file for its process-spawn ban.
# Format: `path:text`, one per line, relative to the project root.  `text`
# is the trimmed source line of the site, so the key is the content of the
# line and not its number.  A row that matches no live site is stale, and
# the check fails until the row is removed.  Write the reason of each row
# in a comment above it.

# The ATen op list is an X-macro argument list, generated by
# utils/scripts/gen-aten-op-table.py.  `clone` is the name of the op aten::clone,
# passed as an argument.  The one X in the tree, in vessel/torch/register.cpp,
# expands it to the type ::at::_ops::clone and never to a call.
vessel/torch/aten_op_table.h:X(1139, clone) \
